name: For the Favor of The Goddess
source:
You are the eldest child of House Andreas.
The next heir to the future generation of The Andreas.

Though, this was cut short as you were chosen to  become the Vessel of Goddess Aster,
The Goddess  from the old fairy tale you read about back when you were a kid.
Now that you're older, you are requested to be in an arranged marriage with the Third Prince? Though with the follower of The Temple of Aster suddenly coming to visit you, things may change depending on what path you'll take!

[From [url=https://grens067.itch.io/for-the-favor-of-the-goddess]itch.io[/url]]
